expected_entries.name: dropped return value

expected_entries.name: inverted comparison
expected_entries.description: Flips a comparison operator to its opposite

expected_entries.name: off by one constant
expected_entries.description: Adds one to an integer constant in a return or comparison

expected_entries.name: swallowed exception
expected_entries.description: Replaces an exception handler body with a silent pass

expected_entries.name: inverted boolean literal
expected_entries.description: Flips a boolean literal to its opposite

expected_entries.name: swapped arithmetic operator
expected_entries.description: Swaps an arithmetic operator for a different one

expected_entries.name: dropped call argument
expected_entries.description: Drops the last argument from a call that takes at least two

expected_entries.name: negated condition
expected_entries.description: Wraps an if condition in a negation

expected_entries.name: removed collection element
expected_entries.description: Removes the first element from a list or dictionary literal

expected_entries.name: range bound shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the last bound of a range call by one

expected_entries.name: wrong variable returned
expected_entries.description: Returns the next parameter instead of the one the code named

expected_entries.name: swapped operand order
expected_entries.description: Swaps the operands of a subtraction, division, floor division, or modulo, where the order of the operands decides the result

expected_entries.name: dropped else branch
expected_entries.description: Drops the else branch of a conditional so the fallback path never runs

expected_entries.name: swapped boolean operator
expected_entries.description: Swaps a boolean and for an or, or an or for an and, in a compound condition

expected_entries.name: dropped await
expected_entries.description: Removes an await so the caller holds a coroutine instead of the awaited result

expected_entries.name: widened exception handler
expected_entries.description: Widens an exception handler so it catches the broad base error type

expected_entries.name: swapped dictionary entry
expected_entries.description: Swaps the key and the value of a dictionary entry so the mapping answers backwards

expected_entries.name: inverted truth test
expected_entries.description: Toggles the negation on a condition test so its sense reads backwards on the shapes no other seed plants

expected_entries.name: reassigned loop variable
expected_entries.description: Points a for loop at a different name already bound in the same scope so the loop writes into the wrong variable

expected_entries.name: swapped call argument order
expected_entries.description: Swaps the first two positional arguments of a call so each value reaches the wrong parameter

expected_entries.name: altered string literal
expected_entries.description: Changes the first character of a string literal so the text the code compares or returns is no longer the text it wrote

expected_entries.name: dropped numeric negation
expected_entries.description: Removes a unary minus so a value carries the opposite sign from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.name: swapped loop control
expected_entries.description: Turns a break inside a loop into a continue so the loop runs on instead of ending

expected_entries.name: swapped augmented assignment operator
expected_entries.description: Swaps the operator of an augmented assignment so the value it accumulates moves the wrong way

expected_entries.name: identity test replaced by equality
expected_entries.description: Replaces an identity comparison with an equality comparison so the test asks sameness of value instead of sameness of object

expected_entries.name: subscript index shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the constant index of a subscript by one so the code reads the element beside the one it named

expected_entries.name: swapped keyword argument values
expected_entries.description: Swaps the values of the first two keyword arguments of a call so each value binds to the wrong parameter

expected_entries.name: swapped raised error
expected_entries.description: Swaps the exception type a raise throws for the first other exception type the module names so the error a caller handles is never the one that arrives

expected_entries.name: slice stop shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the stop of a slice by one so the code takes one element more than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: shifted numeric default

expected_entries.name: swapped sibling attribute

expected_entries.name: narrowed exception handler

expected_entries.name: dropped finally body

expected_entries.name: dropped decorator

expected_entries.name: dropped condition term

expected_entries.name: dropped base class

expected_entries.name: swapped loop control

expected_entries.description: Swaps the operator of an augmented assignment so the value it accumulates moves the wrong way

expected_entries.name: identity test replaced by equality
expected_entries.description: Replaces an identity comparison with an equality comparison so the test asks sameness of value instead of sameness of object

expected_entries.name: subscript index shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the constant index of a subscript by one so the code reads the element beside the one it named

expected_entries.name: swapped keyword argument values
expected_entries.description: Swaps the values of the first two keyword arguments of a call so each value binds to the wrong parameter

expected_entries.name: swapped raised error
expected_entries.description: Swaps the exception type a raise throws for the first other exception type the module names so the error a caller handles is never the one that arrives

expected_entries.name: slice stop shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the stop of a slice by one so the code takes one element more than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: shifted numeric default
expected_entries.description: Raises a numeric argument default by one so a call that leaves the argument out runs with a value the code never wrote

expected_entries.name: swapped sibling attribute
expected_entries.description: Reads the second attribute a scope loads off one object in place of the first so the value comes from a different part of the object than the code named

expected_entries.name: narrowed exception handler
expected_entries.description: Narrows an exception handler that names the broad base error type to the first specific error type its try body raises so the other failures the handler was written to recover from escape past it

expected_entries.name: swapped parameter defaults
expected_entries.description: Exchanges the first two argument defaults of a definition so each parameter falls back to the value the code wrote for the other

expected_entries.name: dropped finally body
expected_entries.description: Drops the finally block of a try statement so the cleanup the code wrote to run on every path never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped decorator
expected_entries.description: Removes the first decorator from a definition so the behaviour the decorator added never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped exception handler
expected_entries.description: Removes the first exception handler of a try statement so the failure it was written to recover from reaches a later handler instead, or escapes to the caller where no handler stands after it

expected_entries.name: dropped yield
expected_entries.description: Replaces each yield with the value it yields so the function runs as an ordinary function and produces none of the items it was written to generate

expected_entries.name: dropped condition term
expected_entries.description: Drops the last term of a compound condition so the cases that term admitted or rejected are decided by the terms that stay

expected_entries.name: dropped base class
expected_entries.description: Removes the first base class of a class definition so the behaviour the class inherited from that base is not there

expected_entries.name: shifted slice start
expected_entries.description: Raises the start of a slice by one so the code takes its elements from one position later than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: reversed loop control
expected_entries.description: Turns a continue inside a loop into a break so the loop ends at the first item it was written to skip and every later item goes unprocessed

expected_entries.name: dropped scope declaration
expected_entries.description: Removes a global or nonlocal declaration so a plain assignment meant for the module or the enclosing scope lands in a local and is lost silently, and an augmented assignment reads that local first and raises instead

expected_entries.name: swapped assignment values
expected_entries.description: Exchanges the first two elements of the tuple an assignment binds so each name takes the value the code wrote for the other

expected_entries.name: dropped loop else clause
expected_entries.description: Drops the else clause of a loop so the code written to run when the loop finishes without a break never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped keyword argument
expected_entries.description: Drops the first keyword argument of a call so the callee never receives the value the caller named for that parameter

expected_entries.name: flipped range step sign
expected_entries.description: Negates the step of a range call carrying three arguments so the sequence travels in the opposite direction from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.name: dropped logical negation
expected_entries.description: Removes a logical not standing outside a condition test so the expression it negated carries the opposite truth from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.description: Removes the first exception handler of a try statement so the failure it was written to recover from reaches a later handler instead, or escapes to the caller where no handler stands after it

expected_entries.name: dropped yield
expected_entries.description: Replaces each yield with the value it yields so the function runs as an ordinary function and produces none of the items it was written to generate

expected_entries.name: dropped condition term
expected_entries.description: Drops the last term of a compound condition so the cases that term admitted or rejected are decided by the terms that stay

expected_entries.description: Removes the first base class of a class definition so the behaviour the class inherited from that base is not there

expected_entries.description: Raises the start of a slice by one so the code takes its elements from one position later than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: reversed loop control
expected_entries.description: Turns a continue inside a loop into a break so the loop ends at the first item it was written to skip and every later item goes unprocessed

expected_entries.name: dropped scope declaration
expected_entries.description: Removes a global or nonlocal declaration so a plain assignment meant for the module or the enclosing scope lands in a local and is lost silently, and an augmented assignment reads that local first and raises instead

expected_entries.description: Turns a break inside a loop into a continue so the loop runs on instead of ending

expected_entries.name: swapped augmented assignment operator
expected_entries.description: Swaps the operator of an augmented assignment so the value it accumulates moves the wrong way

expected_entries.name: identity test replaced by equality
expected_entries.description: Replaces an identity comparison with an equality comparison so the test asks sameness of value instead of sameness of object

expected_entries.name: subscript index shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the constant index of a subscript by one so the code reads the element beside the one it named

expected_entries.name: swapped keyword argument values
expected_entries.description: Swaps the values of the first two keyword arguments of a call so each value binds to the wrong parameter

expected_entries.name: swapped raised error
expected_entries.description: Swaps the exception type a raise throws for the first other exception type the module names so the error a caller handles is never the one that arrives

expected_entries.name: slice stop shifted by one
expected_entries.description: Raises the stop of a slice by one so the code takes one element more than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: shifted numeric default
expected_entries.description: Raises a numeric argument default by one so a call that leaves the argument out runs with a value the code never wrote

expected_entries.name: swapped sibling attribute
expected_entries.description: Reads the second attribute a scope loads off one object in place of the first so the value comes from a different part of the object than the code named

expected_entries.name: narrowed exception handler
expected_entries.description: Narrows an exception handler that names the broad base error type to the first specific error type its try body raises so the other failures the handler was written to recover from escape past it

expected_entries.name: swapped parameter defaults
expected_entries.description: Exchanges the first two argument defaults of a definition so each parameter falls back to the value the code wrote for the other

expected_entries.name: dropped finally body
expected_entries.description: Drops the finally block of a try statement so the cleanup the code wrote to run on every path never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped decorator
expected_entries.description: Removes the first decorator from a definition so the behaviour the decorator added never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped exception handler
expected_entries.description: Removes the first exception handler of a try statement so the failure it was written to recover from reaches a later handler instead, or escapes to the caller where no handler stands after it

expected_entries.name: dropped yield
expected_entries.description: Replaces each yield with the value it yields so the function runs as an ordinary function and produces none of the items it was written to generate

expected_entries.name: dropped condition term
expected_entries.description: Drops the last term of a compound condition so the cases that term admitted or rejected are decided by the terms that stay

expected_entries.name: dropped base class
expected_entries.description: Removes the first base class of a class definition so the behaviour the class inherited from that base is not there

expected_entries.name: shifted slice start
expected_entries.description: Raises the start of a slice by one so the code takes its elements from one position later than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: reversed loop control
expected_entries.description: Turns a continue inside a loop into a break so the loop ends at the first item it was written to skip and every later item goes unprocessed

expected_entries.name: dropped scope declaration
expected_entries.description: Removes a global or nonlocal declaration so a plain assignment meant for the module or the enclosing scope lands in a local and is lost silently, and an augmented assignment reads that local first and raises instead

expected_entries.name: swapped assignment values
expected_entries.description: Exchanges the first two elements of the tuple an assignment binds so each name takes the value the code wrote for the other

expected_entries.name: dropped loop else clause
expected_entries.description: Drops the else clause of a loop so the code written to run when the loop finishes without a break never runs

expected_entries.name: dropped keyword argument
expected_entries.description: Drops the first keyword argument of a call so the callee never receives the value the caller named for that parameter

expected_entries.name: flipped range step sign
expected_entries.description: Negates the step of a range call carrying three arguments so the sequence travels in the opposite direction from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.name: dropped logical negation
expected_entries.description: Removes a logical not standing outside a condition test so the expression it negated carries the opposite truth from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.name: dropped decorator

expected_entries.name: dropped exception handler
expected_entries.description: Removes the first exception handler of a try statement so the failure it was written to recover from reaches a later handler instead, or escapes to the caller where no handler stands after it

expected_entries.name: dropped yield
expected_entries.description: Replaces each yield with the value it yields so the function runs as an ordinary function and produces none of the items it was written to generate

expected_entries.name: dropped condition term
expected_entries.description: Drops the last term of a compound condition so the cases that term admitted or rejected are decided by the terms that stay

expected_entries.description: Removes the first base class of a class definition so the behaviour the class inherited from that base is not there

expected_entries.name: shifted slice start
expected_entries.description: Raises the start of a slice by one so the code takes its elements from one position later than the slice it wrote

expected_entries.name: reversed loop control
expected_entries.description: Turns a continue inside a loop into a break so the loop ends at the first item it was written to skip and every later item goes unprocessed

expected_entries.description: Removes a global or nonlocal declaration so a plain assignment meant for the module or the enclosing scope lands in a local and is lost silently, and an augmented assignment reads that local first and raises instead

expected_entries.name: swapped assignment values

expected_entries.name: dropped keyword argument
expected_entries.description: Drops the first keyword argument of a call so the callee never receives the value the caller named for that parameter

expected_entries.name: flipped range step sign
expected_entries.description: Negates the step of a range call carrying three arguments so the sequence travels in the opposite direction from the one the code wrote

expected_entries.name: dropped logical negation
expected_entries.description: Removes a logical not standing outside a condition test so the expression it negated carries the opposite truth from the one the code wrote
